# MusicKit

<!-- generated:header (isim/tools/coverage-summary.py; do not edit by hand) -->
**Symbols:** 51.1% of Apple's iOS API (470 of 919, exact) · **Rows:** 9: 6 ✅ 3 ❌ · **iOS:** 15.0+
<!-- /generated:header -->

**Area:** [Media](../COVERAGE.md#media) · **Apple:** [MusicKit](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/musickit) · **Issues:** [`area:media`](https://github.com/kolabs-dev/isim/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+label%3Aarea%3Amedia)

## How isim implements it

- **Adapted:** the library is shared with MediaPlayer's simulated library. Catalog requests pass through to the Apple Music API with the developer's token; catalog songs do not play (DRM). Rows: [MediaPlayer](MediaPlayer.md).

## API

| API / feature | Status | iOS | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Catalog items `Genre`, `MusicVideo`, `Station`, `RecordLabel` (with `ContentRating`, `EditorialNotes`, `PreviewAsset`, the `…Filter` protocols); catalog search for them | ✅ | ≤17 | passthrough: decoded from the Apple Music API with the developer token (`ISIM_MUSICKIT_DEVELOPER_TOKEN`); library genres come from the simulated library; isim's library has no music videos; adapted: an item's `FilterType` is the item itself, which conforms to Apple's filter protocol. Tested (HelloMusic -musickit: `test_musickit.py`) |
| `with(_:)` relationships and views | ✅ | ≤17 | passthrough: catalog items are fetched again with `include=` (relationships: albums, artists, genres, music videos, station, tracks, record labels) and `views=` (latest / top releases, more by artist, more in genre); library items already carry theirs. Tested (HelloMusic) |
| `MusicCatalogChartsRequest`, `MusicCatalogChart`, `MusicCatalogChartKind` | ✅ | ≤17 | passthrough: the Apple Music API's charts (songs, albums, playlists, music videos; genre, limit, offset). Tested (HelloMusic) |
| `MusicRecentlyPlayedRequest`, `RecentlyPlayedMusicItem`, `MusicPersonalRecommendationsRequest` | ✅ | ≤17 | passthrough to `/v1/me/…`: needs the music user token too (`ISIM_MUSICKIT_USER_TOKEN`; isim has no Apple ID), else `MusicTokenRequestError.userTokenRequestFailed`. Tested (HelloMusic, with and without the token) |
| `MusicLibrarySearchRequest` | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: searches the simulated library (every word must match; matches at the start of the title rank first), with top results. Tested (HelloMusic) |
| `ArtworkImage`, `MusicSubscriptionOffer`, `View.musicSubscriptionOffer(isPresented:options:onLoadCompletion:)` | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: `ArtworkImage` loads the artwork file or URL at its size; the offer is isim's own sheet saying that there is no Apple Music subscription to offer (catalog playback stays blocked: DRM). Tested (HelloMusic: the sheet and `onLoadCompletion`) |
| Types not yet in isim (iOS 17 and earlier) | ❌ | ≤17 | not implemented, found by the 2026-10 sweep: `AlbumFilter`, `AnyMusicProperty`, `ArtistFilter`, `AudioVariant`, `Curator`, `CuratorFilter`, `DefaultMusicTokenProvider`, `LibraryAlbumFilter`, `LibraryAlbumSortProperties`, `LibraryArtistFilter`, `LibraryArtistSortProperties`, `LibraryGenreFilter`, `LibraryGenreSortProperties`, `LibraryMusicVideoFilter`, `LibraryMusicVideoSortProperties`, `LibraryPlaylistEntryFilter`, `LibraryPlaylistEntrySortProperties`, `LibraryPlaylistFilter`, `LibraryPlaylistSortProperties`, `LibrarySongFilter`, `LibrarySongSortProperties`, `LibraryTrackFilter`, `LibraryTrackSortProperties`, `MusicAttributeProperty`, `MusicCatalogSearchSuggestionsRequest`, `MusicCatalogSearchSuggestionsResponse`, `MusicCatalogTopLevelResourceRequesting`, `MusicDeveloperTokenProvider`, `MusicExtendedAttributeProperty`, `MusicLibraryAddable`, `MusicLibraryRequestFilterValueEquatable`, `MusicLibraryRequestFilterValueMembershipComparable`, `MusicLibrarySection`, `MusicLibrarySectionedRequest`, `MusicLibrarySectionedResponse`, `MusicLibrarySectionRequestable`, `MusicPlaylistAddable`, `MusicPropertySource`, `MusicRelationshipProperty`, `MusicTokenProvider`, `MusicTokenRequestOptions`, `MusicUserTokenProvider`, `PartialMusicAsyncProperty`, `PlaylistFilter`, `RadioShow`, `RadioShowFilter`, `SongFilter`, `TitledSection` (48 types; with their members under "Not yet in isim") |
| Types not yet in isim (iOS 26) | ❌ | 26.4 | not implemented, found by the 2026-10 sweep: `MusicCatalogResourceRequestOption` (1 type; with its members under "Not yet in isim") |
| Types not yet in isim (iOS 27) | ❌ | 27.0 | not implemented, found by the 2026-10 sweep: `PickableMusicItem` (1 type; with its members under "Not yet in isim") |
